title: Senior ML Engineer
description:
Senior ML Engineer

London | £95,000


This is an opportunity to join a growing Machine Learning team focused on building scalable, production-grade solutions that solve complex real-world problems. Working within a greenfield environment, you'll have the chance to shape ML systems from the ground up while delivering measurable impact across a high-volume platform.


The Company

They are a global technology business operating at significant scale, processing billions of transactions and interactions each year. The business is continuing to invest heavily in Data Science, Machine Learning, and automation, with a particular focus on building intelligent products that improve operational efficiency and customer outcomes. Their teams combine strong engineering principles with cutting-edge machine learning to deliver solutions used worldwide.


The Role

  • Build and deploy production machine learning models that support large-scale automation and decision-making
  • Design and optimise data pipelines, backend services, and ML infrastructure
  • Develop and maintain feature stores and model-serving capabilities for real-time and batch use cases
  • Take ownership of projects from problem definition through to production deployment and monitoring
  • Work with structured and unstructured data to solve complex business challenges
  • Collaborate with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product teams to deliver scalable solutions
  • Contribute to the development of greenfield machine learning products and capabilities
  • Drive best practices across MLOps, monitoring, observability, and model lifecycle management


Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience within Machine Learning Engineering, Data Science, or MLOps
  • Experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining machine learning models in production environments
  • Strong SQL and data engineering capabilities, with experience working on large-scale datasets
  • Interest in AI technologies, including NLP, Computer Vision, LLMs, or Generative AI applications
  • Experience building scalable data pipelines and ML systems
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams


How to Apply

If you're interested in this ML Engineer opportunity, please apply with your CV for immediate consideration.
